notes.description: A shotgun that keeps on firing: a little less punch per blast, a lot more blasts.
notes.model: The owner's own Mesoamerican Obsidian Pump Shotgun (Meshy, owned, 2026-11-27; content/guns.json; owner: the Auto Shotgun's model), sharper copies in your own hands at Medium and High; it replaced Styloo's shotgun. The kit auto shotgun is the fallback.
notes.range: Best within 8 m: full damage, 2 body blasts. Down to 25 % (7 blasts) by 28 m; reaches 40 m. Body shots count every pellet on the body (hitscan pellets: by distance).
notes.group: The extended arsenal: every one fires differently. 4: shotguns.
